_protocol: R-041A fiducial single-injection completeness calibration on the real high-z spectra of the measurement population (PI 2026-08-28). One injected absorber per sightline per wave; z_inj proportional to the absorption path inside [3.8, 5.0) under the measurement's 3000 km/s constant-dz collar geometry; SNR_REDSIDE strata from the population's own quantiles on the molly grid; direct support in [20.3, 20.5); trials concentrated where the reported dN/dX(>=20.3) and the threshold response draw their weight; sightlines with an existing production candidate stay in (data-matched MAX_DLAS=1 competition) and are flagged.
_compute: 13 logN x 5 strata: 580 trials per stratum, 2900 injections; ~2.7 CPU-min per spectrum on the archive route -> ~130 CPU-h
